# Maple4K
> Maple4K is an independent Canadian IPTV service: 50,000+ live channels, movies and series in 4K, from $9/month, with a free 24-hour trial and no contract.
> Target markets: Canada (English and French). Serving viewers coast to coast.

## Facts
- Plans (1 connection): $9 / 1 month, $29 / 3 months, $39 / 6 months, $49 / 12 months
- Free trial: 24 hours, no credit card
- Works with: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, XCIPTV, iPlayTV, VLC, Formuler, MAG boxes, Fire Stick, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung and LG smart TVs
